strings.zh: 烈空坐『咕啦咕啦！{NEWLINE}
strings.en: Rayquaza: Kiyuryursheeah!

strings.zh: 坂木『找到白金宝珠了吗？
strings.en: Giovanni: Have you{NEWLINE}found the Griseous Orb?

strings.zh: 冥王『宝珠就在我身上,您看。
strings.en: Charon: I have the{NEWLINE}Orb right here. Look.

strings.zh: 坂木『很好,这样骑拉帝纳{NEWLINE}就是我们的囊中之物了。
strings.en: Giovanni: Excellent. Now{NEWLINE}Giratina is as good as ours.

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『别做白日梦了坂木,{NEWLINE}我会在这里阻止你们的！
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: Stop daydreaming, Giovanni.{NEWLINE}I’m going to stop you right here!

strings.zh: 坂木『哦？有只小狗闻着味道过来了。
strings.en: Giovanni: Oh? A little puppy{NEWLINE}has sniffed its way here.

strings.zh: 冥王『真是阴魂不散……{NEWLINE}老大,要干掉这个臭小鬼吗？
strings.en: Charon: What a pest, haunting{NEWLINE}us everywhere... Boss, shall{CLEAR}I finish off this stinking brat?

strings.zh: 坂木『现在还不是时候,{NEWLINE}按计划去捕捉骑拉帝纳。
strings.en: Giovanni: Not yet. Go{NEWLINE}catch Giratina as planned.

strings.zh: 冥王『是。
strings.en: Charon: Yes, sir.
{VAR:0103:0}: You won’t get away with this!

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『这里就是「那个世界」？{NEWLINE}坂木他们也到了这里吗……？
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: So this is the{NEWLINE}other world? Did Giovanni and{CLEAR}the others come here too...?

strings.zh: 冥王『坂木老大,这里应该就是{NEWLINE}反转世界的尽头了。{CLEAR}请您在这里召唤骑拉帝纳吧！
strings.en: Charon: Boss Giovanni, this should{NEWLINE}be the far end of the Distortion{CLEAR}World. Please summon Giratina here!
strings.notes: 反转世界 → the Distortion World (as the US line 0144 #15)

strings.zh: 坂木『能够反转一切的力量,在这里苏醒……
strings.en: Giovanni: The power to reverse{NEWLINE}all things awakens here...

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『给我住手,坂木！
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: Stop right there, Giovanni!

strings.zh: 冥王『联盟冠军的小鬼？！{SCROLL}冥王『你怎么会出现在这里？{NEWLINE}难道是被宝珠的力量一起进来的？
strings.en: Charon: The League Champion brat?!{SCROLL}Charon: How did you get in here? Did{NEWLINE}the Orb’s power pull you in with us?

strings.zh: 坂木『他怎么来的并不重要,{NEWLINE}我现在需要时间召唤骑拉帝纳,{CLEAR}你给我拖住这个家伙。
strings.en: Giovanni: How they got here doesn’t{NEWLINE}matter. I need time to summon Giratina.{CLEAR}Hold this one off for me.
strings.notes: zh 他 (him) only; no female-player variant [D-2062 meaning-review-30: independently LLM-reviewed source-faithful correction; not human-approved.]

strings.zh: 冥王『好的老大,交给我吧！
strings.en: Charon: Very well, Boss. Leave it to me!

strings.zh: 冥王『我虽然不是你的对手,{NEWLINE}但拖延一会儿还是做得到的！
strings.en: Charon: I may be no match for you,{NEWLINE}but I can still stall you for a while!

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『没有精灵了就赶紧让开,{NEWLINE}不要挡路！
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: You’re out of Pokémon,{NEWLINE}so move! Out of my way!

strings.zh: 冥王『嘿嘿,太迟了………
strings.en: Charon: Heh heh. Too late...

strings.zh: 坂木『骑拉帝纳！{NEWLINE}以这白金玉为信物,{CLEAR}我在此将你召唤,{CLEAR}现身吧！
strings.en: Giovanni: Giratina! By this Griseous Orb{NEWLINE}as a token, I summon you here. Appear!

strings.zh: 骑拉帝纳『Giiii——ra！
strings.en: Giratina: Giiii-ra!

strings.zh: 坂木『你就是骑拉帝纳吗？{NEWLINE}跟画册里有腿的样子不太一样啊。
strings.en: Giovanni: So you’re Giratina? You don’t{NEWLINE}look much like the one with legs in the{CLEAR}picture books.
strings.notes: Giratina shows up in Origin Forme (no legs); ext-review RA-015

strings.zh: 坂木『也罢,这都不重要。{NEWLINE}从今天起你就是我的手下了。{CLEAR}去吧特制球！
strings.en: Giovanni: Well, none of that{NEWLINE}matters. From today on, you’re{CLEAR}my servant. Go, Special Ball!

strings.zh: 坂木『很好,这样一来{NEWLINE}终于可以逆转那该死的诅咒,{CLEAR}到达冰之通路最深处了。
strings.en: Giovanni: Excellent. Now I can finally{NEWLINE}reverse that damned curse and reach{CLEAR}the deepest part of the Ice Path.

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『别做梦了坂木,{NEWLINE}这个世界无法使用穿洞绳,{CLEAR}你已经无处可逃了,{CLEAR}跟我回去认罪是你唯一的出路。
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: Dream on, Giovanni. Escape{NEWLINE}Ropes don’t work in this world. You’ve{CLEAR}got nowhere to run. Coming back with{CLEAR}me to face justice is your only way out.

strings.zh: 坂木『哈哈哈,穿洞绳？{NEWLINE}拥有白金宝珠和骑拉帝纳的我{CLEAR}离开这里还需要穿洞绳吗？
strings.en: Giovanni: Hah hah hah! Escape Rope?{NEWLINE}With the Griseous Orb and Giratina,{CLEAR}do I need an Escape Rope to leave?

strings.zh: 坂木『再见了,联盟冠军{VAR:0103:0}。
strings.en: Giovanni: Farewell,{NEWLINE}League Champion {VAR:0103:0}.

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『又被他们逃掉了……{NEWLINE}不过刚刚坂木说{CLEAR}要去冰之通路的最深处。{CLEAR}现在追去那里的话,{CLEAR}或许能够阻止他们的下一步计划。
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: They got away again...{NEWLINE}But Giovanni just said he’s going to{CLEAR}the deepest part of the Ice Path.{SCROLL}If I go after them there now, I might{NEWLINE}be able to stop their next move.

strings.zh: 啊……坂木老大和冥王大人{NEWLINE}钻到奇怪的树丛里之后{CLEAR}嗖的一下就不见了！{SCROLL}这、这、这……到底是怎么回事啊。
strings.en: Ah... Boss Giovanni and Master{NEWLINE}Charon went into that weird thicket,{CLEAR}and then whoosh, they vanished!{SCROLL}Wh-wh-what on earth is going on?

strings.zh: 你是联盟冠军{VAR:0103:0}！{SCROLL}不过我现在没功夫理你,{NEWLINE}我得赶紧找到{CLEAR}离开这个该死地方的路才行。
strings.en: You’re the League Champion, {VAR:0103:0}!{SCROLL}But I don’t have time for you{NEWLINE}now. I’ve got to find a way out{CLEAR}of this damned place, fast.

strings.zh: 这里就是反转世界吗……{NEWLINE}阴森森的好可怕啊。
strings.en: So this is the Distortion World...{NEWLINE}It’s so dark and creepy.

strings.zh: 骑拉帝纳可能就在前面沉睡,{NEWLINE}要使用白金宝珠召唤骑拉帝纳吗？
strings.en: Giratina might be sleeping up ahead. Use{NEWLINE}the Griseous Orb to summon Giratina?

strings.zh: 骑拉帝纳出现了！
strings.en: Giratina appeared!

strings.zh: 古老的精灵雕像。
strings.en: An ancient Pokémon statue.

strings.zh: 雕像上散发出神奇的力量！
strings.en: The statue is giving off{NEWLINE}a mysterious power!

strings.zh: 雕像与身上的白金宝珠产生了共鸣！
strings.en: The statue is resonating with{NEWLINE}the Griseous Orb you carry!
